evidence.title: Buzz README.md
evidence.locator: Getting started; Quick start; Windows prerequisites
evidence.finding: Default relay is localhost:3000; packaged clients can switch relay. Source setup requires Docker and Hermit or the listed Rust/Node/pnpm toolchain. Production Compose supports a single-node VPS relay. Windows agent shell requires Git Bash or BUZZ_SHELL.

evidence.title: Buzz ARCHITECTURE.md
evidence.finding: buzz-acp runs 1–32 subprocesses, default one, queues mentions per channel with at most one prompt in flight, respawns crashed agents, and does not persist its state. Workflow concurrency is 100 permits and returns CapacityExceeded rather than queueing; cron evaluates every 60 seconds.

evidence.title: Buzz ARCHITECTURE.md
evidence.locator: buzz-auth; buzz-db; buzz-pubsub; buzz-audit; Known limitations
evidence.finding: Channel membership roles are Owner, Admin, Member, Guest and Bot, with transactional member/channel operations and soft removal. NIP-42 and NIP-98 authenticate signed events. Audit is append-only SHA-256 hash chained, excludes ephemeral events, and can verify chains. Approval workflow gates are not wired end to end.
